subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should owner/human handoff be implemented first as a WhatsApp-owned opt-in feature, or designed as a shared cross-channel contract?
rationale: The missing behavior is visible in current source, but the fix adds user-facing config, per-conversation pause state, and resume semantics that need maintainer-owned product direction before automation implements it.

options.title: Opt-in WhatsApp handoff first
options.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Design shared channel contract
options.body: Define common channel-level human takeover semantics before implementation so WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord share one contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep relying on manual controls and instruction-level workarounds if maintainers do not want another auto-reply policy surface right now.

recommendation.title: Opt-in WhatsApp handoff first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp-owned owner handoff config and per-DM pause/resume behavior with no default behavior change and live WhatsApp proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The recommended narrow first implementation is in WhatsApp-owned access-control and auto-reply paths recently touched by mcaxtr.
